business_summary: Odyssey Marine Exploration, Inc. (Nasdaq: OMEX) sits on the nodule-mining-refining/ccz-nodule-resource link (CROWDED) through equity investments in two Cook Islands seabed-mineral exploration license holders, CIC and OML (whose subsidiary Moana Minerals holds a license), plus its own autonomous benthic mini-lander (ABML) exploration work.
